title: SentinelDao
tagline: A policy-driven agent that manages DAO treasury payouts autonomously and onchain.
description: This project is an agent-driven Web3 commerce and payments system designed to simplify how users, freelancers, and DAOs create, manage, and settle payments on-chain. It combines smart contracts, programmable payment logic, and an AI-assisted agent layer to automate invoicing, conditional payments, and treasury actions across chains. The goal is to reduce manual ops, improve transparency, and enable compliant, composable financial flows for modern digital work.
how_its_made: This project was built as a modular Web3 treasury dashboard using Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript on the frontend, with scaffold-eth providing contract bindings, wallet connectivity, and testnet deployment. Smart contracts handle treasury logic, automated policies, and USDC flows, while the UI orchestrates policy creation and monitoring. ENS is integrated via wagmi / viem ENS reads against Ethereum mainnet (read-only) to resolve human-readable identities into recipient addresses and to fetch portable payment metadata via ENS text records. This allows users to configure policies using ENS names while execution remains on testnet. The separation of ENS identity resolution from contract execution is intentional and mirrors real production setups. The implementation is fully open-source, avoids hard-coded values, and was optimized for rapid iteration during the hackathon.
